name: llama.cpp
summary: AI-generated code is accepted, but contributors must disclose meaningful AI use, review and fully understand every line, and be able to explain it without AI help; fully autonomous agents and automated submissions are not allowed. AI-written bug reports, feature requests, PR descriptions, commit messages and reviewer replies are prohibited.

evidence.quote: AI-generated code is allowed. You are 100% responsible for every line, however it was produced.
Explicitly disclose the manner in which AI was employed.
Perform a comprehensive manual review prior to submitting the pull request.
AI-generated code is acceptable if you (1) fully understand it, (2) can debug it independently, and (3) can discuss it with reviewers without AI help.
Do NOT commit or push without explicit human approval for each action.
It is strictly prohibited to use AI to write your posts for you (bug reports, feature requests, pull request descriptions, Github discussions, responding to humans, ...).
Automated commits or PR submissions (may result in contributor ban)
Do NOT write PR descriptions, commit messages, or reviewer responses
AI-written PR descriptions, commit messages, or reviewer responses
